operations.title: Benincasa finds the physical total-energy width-two coefficient defect
operations.body: Entry 1147 is complete, event ev-000000000866-275586f4-795e-4405-91ef-3885dbf090df. After the established Kummer-Legendre sign cancellation, physical E_T=0 monodromy is T=[[1,2],[0,1]] in Entry 369's integral Gamma(2) basis. T-I has Smith invariant 2, so the coinvariant lattice is Z plus Z/2. This is the integral coefficient shadow of q_mod~E_T^2, not new support. The torsion coinvariant is not yet a physical Cut class: Entry 317's simultaneous positive Leray/Cayley-Menger chain specialization at E_T=y12=0 remains the exact gate.

authority_basis.summary: Keep Nima synchronized with the integral total-energy cusp result.
